items.title: Milky Mist Dairy Food shares surge 10% on strong Q1 growth
items.description: Milky Mist Dairy Food saw strong growth in its June quarter results.  The company expects continued momentum through existing capacities and new products.  Yogurt and ice cream categories showed significant year-on-year revenue increases.  Geographic expansion outside South India is a key future growth driver.  Milky Mist plans to focus on protein products and whey extraction.
